Detrick Gymnasium]] |champion = |tourney= |tourney_result = }} {{2022–23 Northeast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Connecticut State University]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils, led by 2nd-year head coach [[Patrick Sellers]], played their home games at the [[William H. Detrick Gymnasium]] in [[New Britain, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Northeast Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 8–24, 5–13 in NEC play to finish tied for eighth place. As the 9 seed, they defeated 8 seed [[2021–22 Fairleigh Dickinson Knights men's basketball team|Fairleigh Dickinson]] in the opening round of the [[2022 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC Tournament]],{{Cite news|url=https://ccsubluedevils.com/sports/mbkb/2021-22/releases/20220228p039f4|title=Men's Basketball Advances in NEC Tournament with Win at FDU
